auxiliary_interlacing.scope: Full stable canonical spectra, including mixed coordinate-momentum couplings and auxiliaries whose frequencies vanish with momentum. The original two canonical pairs remain a principal subspace. Tests verify symplectic interlacing and the sign of the static Schur correction.

coulomb_minimization.scope: Positive local electric energy with an imposed divergence constraint yields a positive inverse Laplacian on zero-mean sources. This static minimization does not remove canonical transverse modes or establish compatible tensor Gauss laws.

dirac_dynamics.scope: An exact three-pair Gaussian model. Substituting the two constraints into its positive energy gives an apparent oscillator only if the original bracket is incorrectly retained. Correct Dirac reduction gives two free canonical pairs and constant original q,p.

tensor_constraint_algebra.scope: The continuum current pairings have rank two at nonzero momentum (real coefficient convention, with Fourier reality partners understood). An independently contracted exact finite-lattice pair from the frozen compact audit also has nonzero Weyl charge pairing. Independent electric Gauss constraints therefore do not commute.

scope: Stable canonical auxiliary oscillators leave at least two O(k^3) frequencies when the compact tensor quadratic block survives as a canonical principal subspace. Constrained electric minimization supplies a positive inverse Laplacian, but the two proposed tensor-current Gauss laws fail to commute. Exact Dirac reduction of a minimal example eliminates the apparent oscillator obtained by naive substitution. These are conditional Gaussian and constraint benchmarks, not a finite-spin phase theorem, nonlinear Einstein gravity, or TOE. No new Lean theorem.
